verdict.rationale: A tax-filing and transparency portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on a user's filings or data, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only Webfile filing, lookup tools, open datasets and charts or graphs, with nothing about AI-generated insights or suggestions. Visualizations and raw open data are adjacent features, not AI insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
